author: Samsung
description:
The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Liova from France
Liova gives new life to discarded phones by turning their batteries into reusable power-bank kits.

Partnering with local repair shops, this circular-economy model helps reduce e-waste and supports income opportunities, while encouraging responsible reuse.

Liova reminds us that sustainability starts with rethinking what we already have.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution powers a greener future.
